title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule F: Invoicing, Payment and Collections Terms
content:
Schedule F sets the invoicing and collections figures of each ClearPath Managed IT Services tier.

## F.1 Invoicing and payment

| Tier | Monthly fee invoice day | Payment due (net days after posting) | Largest invoice payable by card (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 1st of the month | 15 | 5000.00 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 1st of the month | 30 | 5000.00 |
| ClearPath Standard | 1st of the month | 30 | 10000.00 |
| ClearPath Professional | 1st of the month | 30 | 10000.00 |
| ClearPath Premier | 1st of the month | 30 | 15000.00 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 1st of the month | 45 | 15000.00 |

The monthly fee invoice is posted on the invoice day, in advance for that month. Payment is due the stated number of calendar days after the invoice posted date. Above the card limit only ACH, wire or check are accepted.

## F.2 Late fees

| Tier | Late fee per month | Grace period after the due date | Minimum late fee per invoice per month (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 1.5 percent | 5 calendar days | 25.00 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 1.5 percent | 5 calendar days | 25.00 |
| ClearPath Standard | 1.5 percent | 5 calendar days | 35.00 |
| ClearPath Professional | 1.5 percent | 10 calendar days | 35.00 |
| ClearPath Premier | 1.5 percent | 10 calendar days | 50.00 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 1.5 percent | 15 calendar days | 50.00 |

The late fee per month is charged on the unpaid balance of an invoice past due beyond the grace period.

## F.3 Suspension and reinstatement

| Tier | Suspension at (days past due of the oldest unpaid invoice) | Written warning before suspension | Termination for non-payment after (days in suspension) | Reinstatement fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 30 | 7 calendar days | 30 | 150.00 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 45 | 10 calendar days | 30 | 250.00 |
| ClearPath Standard | 45 | 10 calendar days | 30 | 250.00 |
| ClearPath Professional | 60 | 10 calendar days | 45 | 350.00 |
| ClearPath Premier | 60 | 15 calendar days | 45 | 450.00 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 75 | 15 calendar days | 60 | 750.00 |

The reinstatement fee is the flat fee to reinstate a suspended agreement.

## F.4 Hypothetical illustration

An invoice posted on the 1st on ClearPath Standard falls due 30 days later; it is past its grace period once more than 5 further calendar days have passed. On ClearPath Monitor the same invoice falls due after 15 days.
